# Load data

```{r}
df <- readRDS("./data/dataset/CA_LTACH_first_clinical_per_quarter_CRKP_genomes_merged_studies_metadata.RDS")   
```

# Subset dataset to studies

```{r}  
df_201415 <- df%>% subset(study == "2014-15")
df_202123<- df%>% subset(study == "2021-23")
```

# Load carbapenemase data
```{r}
carbapenemase_content <- readRDS("./data/carbapenemase_content/carbapenemase_content_merged_studies.RDS")
df <- left_join(df,carbapenemase_content)

df$carbapenemase_md <- format_carbapenemase(df$carbapenemase) 
```

# A. Count of carbapenemases, with the fill being carbapenemase
```{r} 
df_split <-  df %>%
  separate_rows(carbapenemase_md, sep = " & ")

df_split$carbapenemase_md <- factor(df_split$carbapenemase_md,levels = carbapenemase_scale$breaks)
df_split <- df_split %>% arrange(carbapenemase_md)  

A <- ggplot(data=df_split,
       aes(y=carbapenemase_md, fill=carbapenemase_md)) +
  geom_bar()  + carbapenemase_scale + facet_wrap(~study) +
  geom_text(stat='count',
            aes(label=..count..),
            hjust=-0.05, # push slightly to the right
            size=3.5)  +
  xlim(NA, 420.1) +
  theme_bw_me +
  xlab("Isolates") + ylab("") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size=12, color="black"),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size=12, color="black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color="black"),
                  legend.text =   element_text(size=12, color="black"),
                  legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color="black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 0, color="black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size=14,color='black')
  )

A
```

## C. Perecentage of isolates in ST with the carbapenemase
```{r}  
carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data <- df  %>%
  count(study, Species_ST_recode,carbapenemase_md) %>%
  complete(study, Species_ST_recode, fill = list(n = 0)) %>%
  group_by(study,Species_ST_recode) %>%
  mutate(perc = n / sum(n) * 100)  

carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data$Species_ST_recode <- factor(carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data$Species_ST_recode,levels =  ST_scale$breaks)

carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data <- carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data %>%
  mutate(
    carb_parts = str_split(carbapenemase_md, " & "),
    carb_primary = map_chr(carb_parts, 1),
    carb_secondary_raw = map_chr(carb_parts, ~ if (length(.) > 1) .[2] else NA_character_),
    carb_secondary = ifelse(is.na(carb_secondary_raw), NA_character_, carb_secondary_raw)
  ) %>%
  select(-carb_parts, -carb_secondary_raw)

carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data$carb_primary <-  factor(carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data$carb_primary,levels = carbapenemase_scale$breaks)
carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data$carb_secondary <- factor(carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data$carb_secondary,levels =unique(carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data$carb_secondary) %>% sort(na.last = F)) 

carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data <- arrange(carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data,carb_secondary)

C <- ggplot(
  data = carbapenemase_percentage_ST_data,
  aes(
    y = Species_ST_recode,
    x = perc,
    fill = carb_primary,
    colour = carb_secondary
  )
) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",linewidth = 0.66)  +  carbapenemase_scale_color +
  theme_bw_me +
  xlab("Percentage of isolates") + ylab("") +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_markdown(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 0, color = "black"),
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, color = "black")
  ) +
  carbapenemase_scale +
  facet_wrap(~study)  
 
C
```

# B. Compare carbapenemase genotypes distribution among studies

```{r} 
df_long <- df %>%
  separate_rows(carbapenemase_md, sep = " & ") %>%   # split multi-genotypes
  group_by(isolate_no) %>%
  mutate(weight = 1 / n()) %>%               # fractional allocation
  ungroup()

df_plot <- df_long %>%
  group_by(study, carbapenemase_md) %>%
  summarise(weighted_n = sum(weight), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  mutate(weighted_pct = 100 * weighted_n / sum(weighted_n))
 
df_plot$carbapenemase_md <-  factor(df_plot$carbapenemase_md,levels = carbapenemase_scale$breaks)
    
B <- ggplot(data = df_plot  ,aes(x = study,stratum = carbapenemase_md,alluvium = carbapenemase_md,y=weighted_pct,fill = carbapenemase_md)) +
  geom_alluvium(width=0.66,alpha=0.75) +
  geom_stratum(width=0.66,linewidth = 0.075) + theme_bw_me + xlab("Study") + ylab("Weighted percentage of isolates") + carbapenemase_scale + theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                  axis.text =   element_markdown(size=12, color="black"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color="black"),
                  legend.text =   element_markdown(size=8, color="black"),
                  legend.title = element_markdown(size = 10, color="black"),
                  plot.title = element_text(size = 14, color="black")) + ggtitle("All isolates")  

B
``` 

# D. Compare carbapenemase distribution among Kpn ST258
```{r}
df_long_ST258 <- df  %>% subset(Species_ST == "Klebsiella pneumoniae ST258")  %>% 
  separate_rows(carbapenemase_md, sep = " & ") %>%   # split multi-genotypes
  group_by(isolate_no) %>%
  mutate(weight = 1 / n()) %>%               # fractional allocation
  ungroup()

df_plot_ST258 <- df_long_ST258 %>%
  group_by(study, carbapenemase_md) %>%
  summarise(weighted_n = sum(weight), .groups = "drop") %>%
  group_by(study) %>%
  mutate(weighted_pct = 100 * weighted_n / sum(weighted_n))
 
df_plot_ST258$carbapenemase_md <-  factor(df_plot_ST258$carbapenemase_md,levels = carbapenemase_scale$breaks)

D <- ggplot(data = df_plot  ,aes(x = study,stratum = carbapenemase_md,alluvium = carbapenemase_md,y=weighted_pct,fill = carbapenemase_md)) +
  geom_alluvium(width=0.66,alpha=0.75) +
  geom_stratum(width=0.66,linewidth = 0.075) + theme_bw_me + xlab("Study") + ylab("Percentage of isolates") + carbapenemase_scale + theme(legend.position = "bottom",
                  axis.text =   element_markdown(size=12, color="black"),
                  axis.title = element_text(size = 14, color="black"),
                  legend.text =   element_markdown(size=8, color="black"),
                  legend.title = element_markdown(size = 10, color="black"),
                  plot.title = element_text(size = 14, color="black")) + ggtitle("ST258 isolates")  
D
```

# Construct the figure 
```{r,fig.width=9,fig.height=9} 
AB <-  cowplot::plot_grid(A,B + theme(legend.position = 'none') ,ncol=2,rel_widths = c(1,.33),labels = c("A","B"),label_size=14)  
CD <-  cowplot::plot_grid(C + theme(legend.position = 'none'),D + theme(legend.position = 'none'),ncol=2,labels = c("C","D"),label_size = 14,rel_widths = c(1,.33))

figure_2 <-  cowplot::plot_grid(AB,CD,ncol=1,rel_heights = c(1,1),labels = c("",""),label_size=14)  

figure_2
``` 

```{r}
ggsave(filename = "./figures/figure_2_carbapenemase.png", plot=figure_2, width = 9, height = 9, dpi=900, bg = 'white')
```
